premises.text: Cost of packing and shipping is obscured in online transactions and hard for retailers to determine
premises.evidence_span: There's an element of cost in almost any online transaction that's hidden. It's obscured. It's subsidized

premises.text: Target users are micro-niche SMB retail shippers of heterogeneous real-world goods
premises.evidence_span: small and medium-sized businesses that ship a diverse group of goods. We call them micro niches

premises.text: Fragmented carrier types will not quote unless freight is boxed, crated, or palletized, blocking comparisons
premises.evidence_span: The market itself is incredibly fragmented. Every different type of item requires a different type of carrier

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates carriers into one site that ships almost any size or weight to almost any destination
premises.evidence_span: you can ship almost any item of almost any size or weight to almost any destination from one website

premises.text: Real items are converted to packed weights and dimensions for instant packing and multi-carrier quotes
premises.evidence_span: convert your real item into packed weights and dimensions

premises.text: Pickup, network drop-off, and local delivery complete the fulfillment loop in minutes
premises.evidence_span: schedule a pickup at your home or office. Or you can find a local ShipHawk network location

premises.text: Business model is commissions from shipping, packing, and insurance providers
premises.evidence_span: collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

value.text: Make shipping easy for everyday shippers of awkward real items
value.evidence_span: ShipHawk solves a problem that people experience every day

secondary_value.text: Cut real money and time spent arranging packing and shipping
secondary_value.evidence_span: It costs people real money and real time

causal_links.evidence_span: This allows us to provide customers with instant data, instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes
